active_rule_ids.description:
ActiveRuleIDs is every enabled rule targeting the instance's service,
priority order — the set the kill-switch disables. It is broader than
the poll set: a rule attached to a pending phase is listed here but is
only served once its phase runs (see RuleRepo.ForService).

recent_run_ids.description:
RecentRunIDs is the ids of the most recent phases (up to 5, newest-
started first) that froze this service or attached a rule targeting it.
A "run" is a phase (see /api/v1/phases).

routes.description:
Routes is the HTTP route inventory the service published at
registration. Optional — services may register without routes
(e.g. gRPC services). Aggregated across instances by the
workflow-builder catalog handler.

enabled.description:
Enabled gates serving on every channel (poll predicate AND phase-start
push). Deliberately zero-value FALSE: a create that omits it yields a
disabled rule, which is what makes the create→attach→enable experiment
flow ordering-safe. Do not add default-true anywhere in the create path.

info.description:
Central coordination controller for the atropos ecosystem.
Manages rules, faults, experiments, workflows, and SDK lifecycle.
info.title: Manteion Control-Plane API

get.description:
Lists every supported (category, fault_type) pair with its
params field metadata (name/type/required/default) so
clients can render fault forms without hardcoding the vocab.
Returns all fault compositions in creation order.

post.description:
Persist a composition (parallel or sequential group of fault members).
Validates depth (max 3), per-member directions, and pairwise fault
incompatibilities against the current spec/composition repos.

get.description: Returns all fault specs in creation order.

post.description:
Persist an atomic fault definition. The body is validated per
model.FaultSpec.Validate() — category in {inline,network,resource},
fault_type matches the category, and config is non-empty.

put.description:
Replace all mutable fields of an existing fault spec. The body
is validated identically to creation; id is taken from the URL
and created_at is preserved from the stored record.

get.description: Returns 200 if the process is running. No dependency checks.
Returns 200 once the database is reachable, 503 otherwise.
Returns all configured rules, ordered by priority descending.

post.description:
Persist a new rule. Action.Type discriminates between fault_spec,
fault_composition, and cachebox — exactly one payload must be set.
Rules are created DISABLED unless "enabled": true is explicit; for
experiment-attached rules, create → attach → enable (in that order)
is the leak-safe lifecycle.

400.description: validation error or infrastructure failure (currently collapsed; see openapi-conventions.md known gaps)

put.description: Replace an existing rule. The id in the path overrides any id in the body.

get.description:
Returns 200 with status="ready" when manteion is ready to
serve rules. Used by atropos-go SDKs as a startup gate.

Returns all currently registered SDK instances. Status is computed
(alive/stale/dead) from last-poll-at.

Returns the instance's list row (status computed alive/stale/dead
from last-poll-at) plus active_rule_ids — every enabled rule
targeting the instance's service, the set the kill-switch disables —
and recent_run_ids — the most recent phases (up to 5, newest first)
that froze the service or attached a rule targeting it.

post.description:
Disables every currently-enabled rule whose service matches the
instance's service, through the same full rule update as
PUT /rules/{id} — the rule version bumps once per rule, so polling
SDKs converge on their next poll (SSE subscribers are nudged too).
Idempotent: a repeat call reports an empty disabled_rule_ids.

500.description: lookup failed, or some rules could not be disabled — retry; rules already disabled stay disabled

post.description:
Registers an atropos-go SDK process. The 201 response carries
status="registered" and may include the initial desired state
(rules, active_faults, freeze_cfg) so the SDK converges before
its first poll.

201.description: registration ack with optional intent fields

get.description:
SDKs send their last-known rule version via the version query param.
Returns 304 if unchanged, else 200 with the desired state the SDK
reconciles against: {"version": uint64, "rules": []CompiledRule,
"active_faults": []FaultRequest, "freeze_cfg": DelayRequest}.
Manual fault add/remove bumps the version so it rides this path.
Optional instance_id query param triggers a best-effort poll-timestamp touch.

parameters.description: last known rule version (uint64); omit on first poll
parameters.name: version

parameters.description: SDK instance ID for poll-timestamp tracking
parameters.name: instance_id

304.description: no rule changes since requested version
